current_article.title: Coming in January: New Year’s, Mountains of Power, and more! — Pokémon GO
current_article.text:
Updates
Coming in January: New Year’s, Mountains of Power, and more!
January Research Breakthrough rewards
Saturday, January 1, 2022, at 1:00 p.m. to Tuesday, February 1, 2022, at 1:00 p.m. PST (GMT −8).
Update : Due to an unforeseen issue, Research Breakthroughs in January will not be rewarding Steelix Mega Energy. Instead, Timed Research will be available from Saturday, January 1, 2022, at 12:00 a.m. to Monday, January 31, 2022, at 11:59 p.m. local time that will reward a total of 200 Steelix Mega Energy.
Onix
Steelix Mega Energy
*If you’re lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!
Weekly 1 PokéCoin bundles
Every Monday in January, a one-time-purchase bundle containing a Remote Raid Pass and other items will be available in the shop for 1 PokéCoin.
Featured Pokémon in raids
The following Pokémon will be appearing in raids throughout January.
Five-Star Raids
Regice and Heatran will be returning to five-star raids this January! Also, for the first time in Pokémon GO, Genesect with a Shock Drive will be appearing in five-star raids!
Please note: Raid rotations start and end at 10:00 a.m. local time on the dates listed.
Until Friday, January 7, 2022

Raid Hours
Every Wednesday in January, a Raid Hour event will occur from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time. The following Pokémon will be featured.
January 5: Kyurem
January 12: Heatran
January 19: Genesect (Shock Drive)
January 26: Regice
*If you’re lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!
November 3: The Mythical Pokémon Darkrai
November 10: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion
November 17: Cresselia
November 24: Cresselia
Pokémon Spotlight Hours
In the month of January, Pokémon Spotlight Hour will take place every Tuesday from 6:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time, and each will spotlight a different Pokémon and a special bonus!
January 4: Solosis | 2× Transfer Candy
January 11: Diglett | 2× Catch Stardust
January 18: Plusle | 2× Catch Candy
January 25: Minun | 2× Transfer Candy
*If you’re lucky, you might encounter a Shiny one!
January Community Day
Join us on Sunday, January 16, 2022, from 11:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time for a Community Day event featuring Spheal, the Clap Pokémon!
Spheal will be appearing more frequently in the wild. Evolve Sealeo (Spheal’s Evolution) during the event or up to two hours afterward to get a Walrein that knows the Charged Attack Icicle Spear and Fast Attack Powder Snow.
For more details, check out the January Community Day blog .
Upcoming events
Stay tuned for details about these upcoming events.
New Year’s Event : From Friday, December 31, 2021, at 10:00 p.m. to Tuesday, January 4, 2022, at 8:00 p.m. local time, ring in the new year with Pokémon in new costumes and snazzy new avatar items!
Mountains of Power : From Friday, January 7, 2022, at 10:00 a.m. to Thursday, January 13, 2022, at 8:00 p.m. local time, work with Spark to activate the second part of the mysterious door by journeying through terrain reminiscent of the mountains found in regions like Johto and Sinnoh.
Electric- and Steel-themed event inspired by the Kanto Power Plant : From Wednesday, January 19, 2022, at 10:00 a.m. local time to Tuesday, February 1, 2022, at 10:00 a.m. local time, continue working with Spark to gather up some electrifying Pokémon to activate the final part of the mysterious door . It seems that some nefarious forces have also caught wind of the door and the power it may contain…
Please be aware of your surroundings and follow guidelines from local health authorities when playing Pokémon GO. Upcoming events are subject to change. Be sure to follow us on social media, opt in to receiving push notifications, and subscribe to our emails to stay updated. For the latest on in-game events and feature updates, be sure to check this help center article .
—The Pokémon GO team
